items_par_level.name: items_par_level
items_par_level.value: par_level is null or (reorder_point is not null and par_level > reorder_point)

adjustment_requests_other_decider.name: adjustment_requests_other_decider
adjustment_requests_other_decider.value: decided_by is null or decided_by <> created_by or status = 'CANCELLED'

stock_movements_sale_once.name: stock_movements_sale_once
stock_movements_sale_once.where: order_id is not null and reason_id is null

stock_movements_sale_order.name: stock_movements_sale_order
stock_movements_sale_order.value: type::text <> 'SALE_RECIPE' or order_id is not null

stock_movements_order_type.name: stock_movements_order_type
stock_movements_order_type.value: order_id is null or type::text in ('SALE_RECIPE', 'REVERSAL', 'LOSS')

orders_cancel_note.name: orders_cancel_note
orders_cancel_note.value: cancel_reason is distinct from 'OTHER' or cancel_note is not null

tab_events_user.name: tab_events_user
tab_events_user.value: kind = 'OPENED' or user_id is not null

tab_payments_cash.name: tab_payments_cash
tab_payments_cash.value: case when method = 'CASH' then received is not null and change >= 0 and received = amount + change else received is null and change is null end

table_tabs_closed.name: table_tabs_closed
table_tabs_closed.value: num_nonnulls(closed_at, closed_by, closed_day, subtotal, service_charge, total) = case when status = 'CLOSED' then 6 else 0 end
